description: Eight input and output pairs wired straight through, in 4HP, each with a mute and a normalling chain down the column

params.text: Chooses how the normalling runs: ON carries a patched input down to every empty jack below, OFF makes every port independent, the middle position carries it down until a muted port stops it
Breaks that port's connection while it is red, so its output carries the mute voltage instead of its input

inputs.text: The signal for that port; with the jack empty it reads the nearest patched input above it unless normalling is off

outputs.text: Carries the input of the same number, or the mute voltage while that port is muted

notes: with a signal in the first input and normalling on, the other seven outputs carry it too, giving a mult with one section per patched input
two side by side make a patchbay: fix the outside cables once, then repatch between the two; set the second module's normalling to OFF so its outputs carry only their own inputs
menu: Mute voltage — sets the voltage a muted output carries, 0V unless you change it
Set mute: ON, OFF — sets all eight mute buttons at once
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
